bias.en: Uptrend · slipped back below the 10-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 回落至 10 日均线下方

read.en: Palantir fell 2.7% on Oct 22 to $196.19, trading between $194.54 and $202.63. It is above the falling 5-day ($194.1) and the rising 30-day ($189.9), 100-day ($159.1) and 200-day ($153.1) averages, and below the rising 10-day ($199.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 but is above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($208.30), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: Palantir 10月22日下跌 2.7%，收于 $196.19，盘中区间 $194.54–202.63。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$194.1）以及上行的 30 日（$189.9）、100 日（$159.1）和 200 日均线（$153.1）上方，低于上行的 10 日均线（$199.9）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴之上；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$208.30），RSI 为 54。

read.en: The close slipped back under the 10-day average but held the 5-day, and the high again stalled at $202.6. Resistance is $199.9 (10-day), then $202.6–203.6 (Oct 16, 21 and 22 highs) and $208.3 (SAR). Support is $194.1–194.5 (5-day, day's low), then $189.4–189.9 (30-day, Oct 20–21 lows) and $184.5. A close above $203.6 would open $208–213; a close below $189.4 would open $184.5.

r.zh: 抛物线 SAR；52周高点 $212.9（10月12日）
